name: Relentless physical crits cut the owned Aortic Assault rank's cooldown (#694, #9472)
contract: Relentless 704652 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL on Relentless 807357 for physical critical strikes, and its tooltip promises that each such crit reduces the cooldown of Aortic Assault by $/1000;807358s1 sec. That reduction is Relentless 807358, a single SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN with BasePoints -1001 whose MiscValue 806212 is rank 1 of the Aortic Assault chain (spell_ranks 806212..807785). A level-55 Bloodmage casts rank 5, 807783, so the cooldown the player sees and the one Spell::CheckCast enforces is 807783's. Every rank shares Category 53 with RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime 20000, so a control Bloodmage without Relentless who casts the same rank immediately afterwards carries a cooldown at least as long; the Relentless Bloodmage's 807783 cooldown can only fall below the control's through the proc. Crit Test Buff 503747 (aura 290, +100 percentage points) makes every strike crit: Aortic Assault's own periodic Physical strikes 806502 and Bloodfang Bite 572551 (SchoolMask 1, DmgClass 2) are both physical. The control proves crits alone move nothing.
